notes.title: The small update last night
notes.content:
Hello! Maybe you didn't even notice this yet but I patched a small yet vital update through last night. One was to fix a big exploit I stumbled upon the other day and another was a neat graphical touch.

Bug fix:

It turns out that you could totally cheese the hell out of the Super Boss by opening your prayer book right before he was about to perform any action and it'd cancel his action completely (!) Wow I can't believe nobody had noticed that before, including me haha. So now he's been fixed and is as difficult as intended.

Graphical touch:

If you equip the Badass Badge which makes you look like a Templar knight, the big picture of the cleric on the Subscreen now changes to that of ... A Templar too! Wow, right?

--

In other events, this September sale has been a huge hit! I gotta say thanks a lot and it really means a lot to me that more people are playing and discovering my game. The sale still has quite a few days left so I'm hoping for even more players to join my wacky cast of characters 'In Towwwwwnnnnnn!'

Viva la Cleric! ːJAC_Clericː

notes.title: DXF Games update
notes.content:
Hello!

Sorry I haven't been as vocal on Steam as I have been lately, but I wanted to take some time today to explain what's going on with DXF Games.

For the past couple weeks I've been hard at work on updating one of my older games to be Steam compatible for an eventual Greenlight offering. The game actually takes place below the town in Just a Cleric, however it's a roguelike whose main star is an Xtoli. If you've played JAC since the expansion, that's one of those gray rabbit things underground.

The game's called Equin The Lantern, and it sports a Dragon Quest style battle system. My inspirations for this one were DQ, Diablo, and Dark Souls. The three D's! Dragon Quest in its battle system, Diablo in its randomness and things like champion monsters, and Dark Souls in that everything requires a bit of Stamina to execute. Also the lore is not immediately known to the player but is found out through bribing guild members and etc. Each weapon has its own set of actions in battle to some degree, like a sword that can slash but a weaker knife has the option to both slash and stab. 

There are some cool and original things in this as well. The lantern is a mysterious object that appeared one day and your job is to set out and find out what it does. What it DOES DO is change colors through 5 different phases while you play. Depending on its color, some of the game's rules will change. This is up to the player to discover either through trial and error or more likely through those lovable, bribable, guild members.

So what's new? First off is I've remade the thing to include gamepad support. It's not necessary but it is pretty cool and I've been using it a lot these couple weeks myself when I test things. Second is there's now a save system (hooray!) which was a giant giant pain in the butt to add and took almost three days but it's done and working now. Thirdly is NEW CONTENT of course! We have some new floor events like a snow level, and things like jail gates you can open that house some pretty dangerous mofos. Mushrooms grow in the dark and can be eaten to heal you- or maybe poison you!

More as it develops, this is what I've been up to ːJAC_Cowː

notes.title: Balancing Act, Part 2
notes.content:
[I]Steam.. The FINAL frontier
These are the voyages of the game.. JUST A CLERIC
Its ongoing mission: To strike that PERFECT BALANCE between YES! and AHHH, THIS SUCKS!
To keep doing this until the end of time if necessary..
TO BOLDLY DO WHAT MANY JAC VERSIONS FAILED TO DO BEFORE[/I]


[b]THINGS YOU WILL PROBABLY LIKE[/b]
[list]

[*]There's now a warhammer available in the badass challenge dungeon. It has a scaling critical hit chance and a 150% STR attack influence.

[*]Fixed a bug where you had to wait for the wand's magic projectile to fly off the entire mission map before shooting another one (instead of just off the visible screen.) This makes for a huge improvement. Thanks Kaluroth for pointing this out!

[*]Fixed a bug where if you tried an unarmed punch attack while pressing UP you couldn't attack. This also happened while climbing up ladders.
[/list]


[b]THINGS YOU WILL LIKE IF YOU LIKE A CHALLENGING EXPERIENCE[/b]
[list]
[*]Added blobs to the NG+ Water Me Timbers mission.

[*]Added skeleton mages to the NG+ Wicked Pissah mission.

[*]Added another drake to the NG+ Dragonslayer mission (volcano range).

[*]New enemy: Dire Jays. Tougher blue jays that replace the regular version in the Cardinal Rule NG+ mission. They'll also show up in the first half of the SPF3000 mission in NG+ if you spring the floating platform trap like normal.
[/list]


[b]THINGS YOU WILL PROBABLY NOT LIKE BUT HEY WHO KNOWS[/b] 

[list]
[*]All hidden stat icons on NG+ now have a chance to not be there at all. I really feel like having these be consistently there for each NG+ run just made the cleric too powerful and thus made the game too easy after a while and not fun anymore. Even with the recent level cap you could just get too strong in actual fact. I'm reminded of the original NES Super Mario brothers and how there were invisible 1UP mushrooms you could get by jumping in certain places BUT they were not there 100% of the time. (There's one in World 1-1 and another on a bridge in 3-1, another in 4-1 and etc). This actually helped me make this tough decision today.
[/list]


[b]THINGS YOU PROBABLY HAVEN'T NOTICED YET AND THAT'S GOOD[/b] 

[list]
[*]Just like the punch attack + UP bug above, turns out this was also happening with both of the new cursed weapons (Demon Head and Killer Fist) and for The Weebinizer flail. All have been fixed and now will attack properly even if you're pressing UP or climbing up a ladder like everything else does.

[*]The sand storms in the Water Me Timbers mission in NG+ now stop while you have your subscreen or prayer book open.

[*]Fixed a bug where attacking the same enemy twice in a row with the Demon Head while in the Water Me Timbers mission wouldn't count as a hit. (This is because for that mission the cleric has an extra animaton for watering the plants and it threw this off, believe it or not.)
[/list]

As obviously I've invested a ton of time in this game I want to strike the right balance. ːJAC_Clericː

notes.title: Balancing Act
notes.content:
Trying to get your game to be 'just right' sometimes takes quite a while. The good thing with the Steam client if you're a dev is that you're able to quickly reach and replace your player base's copies of the game, which sadly is tough to do someplace else. Getting JAC's difficulty correct is always a concern of mine, for example. First I made a level cap of 16, but the existance of those invisible stat icons sort of made this moot. So I've tweaked this mechanic a bit now (more below).

I've been watching a lot of Just a Cleric 'Let's Plays' lately and have noticed some things that I wanted to address in the game. I've also noticed some other things that have popped up due to my 'fixing' the weapon hit boxes that needed fixing because they were TOO accurate. Let's say for example the animation of the mace went from up diagonal to down diagonal in the other direction. If there was a monster right in that spot in between you wouldn't hit it. And that's no good!

So here's a list of all the changes, some I think you will like and some we'll let history decide for itself:

[b]THINGS YOU WILL PROBABLY LIKE[/b]
[list]

[*]Mace, Club, and The Defender all got improved hitboxes (these all count as small, mace-class weapons).

[*]Healing Touch got a power boost. The new formula is (Faith x 2) + random (1 to 7) points of healing. Too many times players will have to spam healing- which is understandable given this isn't an easy game- but this new tweak will not only make the healing less needed, it means the prayer gets stronger earlier.. leaving more opportunity to invest in another stat should you choose.

[*]Cross Toss also got a damage boost. For a huge, spinning, magical cross that can go through walls it just didn't have quite the POP it needed. The new damage formula is (Faith) + 5. Everything else about it is unchanged.

[*]Every cursed item at the hidden shop except Ryu's Mitt had its price significantly reduced. I figure all of these could be really helpful to newer players but most are outclassed by gold gear. Except Ryu's Mitt which can be mighty useful in a lot of applications without too much of a negative side.

[*]The Rental Bat (remember him!?) now has more life during NG+ (10 -> 15) and will stick around longer should you decide to have him at your side.

[*]The Gauntlet mission now gives you 500 XP and 2 Demon Eyeballs for a quest reward (used to be a Gold Ring and XP, which still happens at NG+).

[*]Treasure chests in Grind-O-Rama got an HP decrease from 8 to 3. I figure since you start out with nothing for these challenges, who wants to beat a chest to death for 10 seconds straight, right?
[/list]


[b]THINGS YOU WILL PROBABLY NOT LIKE BUT HEY WHO KNOWS[/b]
[list]

[*]Hidden Stat Icons can still be found in NG+ as long as you are level 15 or lower. You will still be able to get the Stat Point rewards during the Who's The Boss mission and rarely from black Magic Boxes. I feel this was necessary as going through NG+ again and again can quickly net you a tremendous amount of power and robs the game of a lot of the challenge. Even still, with this new change you'll be able to amass quite a little powerhouse cleric it just won't be to the levels of insanity like before.
[/list]


[b]THINGS YOU PROBABLY HAVEN'T NOTICED YET AND THAT'S GOOD[/b]
[list]

[*]Fixed a bug where opening your prayer book up while at the very bottom of the Cult of No Personality mission obscured the prayer names when the 'BIG BOSS' HP bar was showing. Thanks to Hobidowo as I noticed this while he was fighting the Cult Leader the other day.

[*]Fixed a bug where hitting the Grind-O-Rama weights in the Badass challenge sometimes wouldn't register as a hit (if you were standing too close it'd count as you being on top of the weight and it's not supposed to take damage if that's the case as a safety thing).

[*]Fixed a bug where if you OHK'd the Albino Bat with Fryar Fry while he was still sleeping it'd SCREW EVERYTHING UP. Thanks to old buddy KALUROTH who came out of retirement to let me know about this!
[/list]

Ah yes, I do so love the announcement feature as you can see. Did you know that for each announcement I make Valve doesn't pay me 5 cents? It's true! Now on to the deal:

I had to change how the Priestly Pyro prayer works. Here's how it used to work-

Duration 21 + (FAI / 2) seconds
Damage 1
Chance to inflict burn on enemy: 100%

As you can see, that's pretty strong, but what prompted me to change it is that you could stunlock almost any hard enemy with it for easy kills. Just like I make changes to make things easier for people when they're too hard (example: The dragon checkpoint save room, the Grind-O-Rama dungeon for XP, etc) I also must make changes when I feel ways to cheese the game are discovered. Myself, I never used Priestly Pyro too much so I didn't realize how powerful it really was.

Here's how it works now-

Duration 21 + (FAI / 2) seconds
Damage 2 
Chance to inflict burn on enemy: 100%

Looks like I made it stronger, huh? There's a big difference now though and that is every time the fires strike an ENEMY it will reduce the overall duration by 1 second. So in a short amount of time you can burn blast the hell out of your enemies for more damage than last time but for bosses and other tough SOBs you won't be able to rely on your fires alone anymore because they'll go out much faster.

Trust me guys, this is for the best. But in case you don't think so here's not one but THREE COOKIES I've also included in this new update:

Grind-O-Rama has 3 new gear exclusives that can sometimes be found within. These items will disappear once you leave the challenge dungeons but will be a great help while you're in there since you're forced to fight at such a low level.

"Grind Branch" is a 2-handed magical tree branch you can possibly find while in the WUSS section of the place. It deals STR and FAI damage and has a 25% XP bonus property too. This will be very helpful for you new guys who are using the place to grind up levels for the early parts of the game.

"Ancient Harpoon" is another 2-handed mega spear that can sometimes be found while in the BADASS section of the dungeon. It not only has a chance to burn your foes it also has a brand-new gear property called 'Find Eye' which will increase the chances of enemies within dropping demon eyeballs.

"Stink Eye" is a rare accessory that can also be found in the BADASS section of the Grind-O-Rama. It will also increase the odds that monsters can drop demon eyeballs. And since it's the only accessory in the joint, it will have no competition whatsoever!

---

Adding these new Grind-O-Rama exclusives was really fun and surprisingly easy. I wouldn't bet against seeing some new ones pop up here in the future.

ːJAC_Shinessaː VIVA LA CLERIC! ːJAC_Clericː

notes.content:
After another marathon 13 straight hours of work on this today (!!) I'm happy to say that the JAC expansion is finally done.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=706394658
SCHOLAR OF THE FIRST WUSS is my big 'thank you' to you guys who gave my game a shot when you could have been playing some AAA deal made by 500 professionals with a $50 million dollar budget. 

Here's all of the differences, large and small:


[b]ADDITIONS:[/b]
==========

[list]
[*]Grind-O-Rama, a new repeatible dungeon in which you can earn XP and demon eyeballs, with 2 categories of challenge for those who want to try: 'Wuss' and 'Badass'. Can you survive 3 waves of random enemies with nothing but the gear the dungeon gives you? You can access this as early as level 5. Where is it? Remember, this game has lots of false walls and stuff..

[*]New Cursed Items! A new type of gear for our cleric, cursed items come in blood red bags and are quite powerful, with at least one drawback.

[*]New currency! Collect demonic eyeballs inside Grind-O-Rama and use them at the..

[*]New Shop! Hidden next to the Grind-O-Rama, my old Equin creations make a comeback of sorts and one of them offers to sell you most of the new cursed gear here in exchange for demonic eyeballs. He'll also exchange $20 in cash for 1 of these eyeballs.

[*]New Grind-O-Rama features: The blue Power Potion (gives the 'rages of battle' effect) and Super Homogenized Milk (+100% PP) can be found within. You can also hack down suspended weights on the ceiling and crush any enemies below, or ride the elevators. Both of these are in the 'Badass' challenge.

[*]Hyper Emerson's contest-winning weapon, the Demon Head, can now be had by killing none-other than the Super Demon itself. Can you rise to the challenge and take his OWN FRIGGIN' HEAD to use as a weapon??

[*]The Badass Badge, a new accessory, is a unique item that only drops off the Dragon during the regular game. Wear it and completely change your cleric's appearance to that of a badass Templar Knight in armor.

[*]Two brand new pieces of music from The Booger Myers Band! Took a whole day to do, but was well worth it.

[*]Any blessed weapon (+5) now gains an automatic attack speed increase. This won't show up on the gear's stat page due to space limitations, but you'll notice a difference or my name's not Willy P. Dingledong (which it isn't).

[*]A small new explorable ledge was added to the Dragon's dungeon.

[*]A small text display now shows how many items are in your pack at all the shops.
[/list]


[b]CHANGES:[/b]
=========

[list]
[*]All cleric weapon hitboxes have been revamped. The collision should not be a LOT more accurate, but be warned it's pixel perfect and might take some getting used to!

[*]The cleric's level is now capped at 16. You can still get stat increases from other methods (ex. from black chests or invisible stat icons).

[*]The Twin Gripper ring got an attack boost from +2 to +10 while using a two-handed weapon.

[*]Sand storms can now happen in the 'Water Me Timbers' mission during NG+.

[*]'Goin Batty' mission reward is now a random piece of regular (NG) or silver gear (NG+).

[*]'We Aim to Please' mission reward changed to $15 and 10 arrows.

[*]'Castle of A-Hole' mission reward changed from $150 to $100 cash.

[*]'Isle of Denial' mission reward is now a random piece of silver gear (NG+).

[*]'Quite a Pickle' mission reward changed to $30 cash (was $40).

[*]The Quarters Staff and Magic Shirt got a price reduction at the Enterprising Wizard's. These are now $200 and $120, respectively.
[/list]


[b]BUG FIXES:[/b]
==========

[*]Moved a torch to the layer it's supposed to be on in the desert (thanks to Sauce Bauce's playthrough, this is where I saw it from).

[*]Fixed it so you can no longer get over $9999 from selling stuff at the shop (thanks to Hyper Emerson for breaking the game enough to get this rich lol).

[*]Fixed all the stat displays to show the correct number once you get over 100 points (which is the max 99 plus modifiers from your gear, thanks again Hyper Emerson!)

[*]Fixed a bug where the cleric could get stuck inside a barrel after he got punched by a golem and went sailing through the air, and happened to land inside one. Now if this happens he'll simply destroy the barrel. (Thanks Hyper Emerson!)

[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes the two guards will give you the 'Failed mission' texts while between the regular missions. (I have only myself to thank for this one!)

[*]Fixed the DREADED shield blocking pop up display so it won't show up when an arrow trap shoots anymore. (Thanks to Sauce Bauce who showed me this was really something that needed to be fixed even if it didn't effect the gameplay).
[/list]


---

And I believe that's about it. All in all, I've probably put 100 hours into making this expansion for you in my free time, which of course will be retroactive in case you just bought JAC now or earlier today or something. I plan on releasing this to the core game via an update sometime this upcoming week.

I will be manning the forums like always in case anybody has questions, and will address any issues that pop up from time to time of course, but for now I think I can safetly say:

[b]THE END[/b]

ːJAC_Shinessaː VIVA LA CLERIC! ːJAC_Clericː

notes.title: JAC Progress Report, Part Three!
notes.content:
I've already posted some of these changes on the main thread, but was able to get to a ton of things done on this tonight as well:

---

[list]
[*]The regular game dragon will always drop a specific new cursed item. This is going to be the only way to obtain this particular item as cursed gear can't be found from chests. Upon defeating the dragon in NG+ and beyond it will drop a random piece of gold gear.

[*]The Super Boss will now always drop Hyper Emerson's contest-winning weapon. If you re-enter his area with this special weapon either equipped or in your backpack he will instead drop a random piece of gold gear. If you sell the special weapon or otherwise get rid of it, killing the Super Boss again will get you another contest-winning weapon. You can fight him until the end of time if you want.

[*]Cursed Gear is a thing. They come in red bags and are either really powerful or have an unusual equipment property. In all case, there is at least some sort of negative thing about them (hence CURSED!) This new type of gear can't ever be found in chests randomly like everything else. They also can't ever be upgraded or blessed.

[*]The purple "M" (mode) up in the right hand corner of the HUD that tells you if you're playing a 'N'ormal or 'H'ardcore mode game has been replaced with an EVIL RED EYE. This is the new form of currency- demonic eyeballs! These will only be found within the new grinding area.

[*]The new shop is completed! Just finished tonight, in fact. It's here at the CUSP of the new grinding area where you'll be able to trade in your new eyeball currency for 5 of the new cursed items and a 6th option to exchange 1 eyeball for $20 cash. Since some people had some difficulty obtaining money early on in the game, I thought this would be a good service to add.

[*]I've added a little text to show how many items are in your backpack while visiting the Enterprising Wizard's house (the same pack display that's at the shop currently).

[*]All weapons you bless and get to +5 now receive... An extra swing speed bonus! This bonus unfortunately won't be visible on the weapon's stat page but it's true! The speed boost is slightly better than the one you get while equipped with a Silver Ring. And good news, folks: This speed bonus stacks with any other attack speed booster you have too! (Includes the "Rages of Battle" effect)

[*]The shield block "BLOCKED" display now no longer appears when an arrow shot from an arrow trap hits a wall. It just displays when you, you know, shield block something. Wow!

[*]Bug Fix: If you have $9999 at the shop and sell something the cash won't go above $9999 in there anymore (Thanks Hyper Emerson for getting this much money to find this out!)

[*]Bug Fix: It's rare but possible to get stuck inside a barrel if one of the golem bosses punches you at just the right spot on the 'Isle of Denial' mission. I've made it so that if you do happen to fly into a barrel you'll instead destroy it. (Thanks to Hyper Emerson for finding this!)

[*]If you are in fact the second coming of you-know-who and somehow manage to pump 99 points into a stat.. and have gear that further boosts that stat.. the text display should now correctly show the proper amount. What was happening before is a stat might get truncated (in display only) when you got over 99 total. (Thanks to... oh you know who it was who found this I bet!)

[*]The final Dragon Cave area got a slight addition right above the entrance. You'll need some nifty gear to find a way up there later on but it's worth mentioning since it's new.
[/list]

Not bad for 4 and a half hours of work, I gotta' say!

All this and way more will be in the Expansion to come later, for free and retroactive for all players both old and new.

ːJAC_Shinessaː VIVA LA CLERIC!! ːJAC_Clericː

notes.title: Update #5
notes.content:
Because, you know, the word 'Patch' seems so negative doesn't it? 
So 'Update' it is!

*Last thing- There was a bug where if you got hit by the sleeping magic while your prayer book was open it's get all BUSTED and NOT TOO GOOD. This has been fixed across all areas of the game. 

Thanks for bringing these issues to my attention, good people of the JAC community!

notes.title: Patch #4
notes.content:
I'm not too pig-headed to admit when I make a design flaw. Having 2 tough missions back to back with one of the hardest bosses in the game right afterwards was, in retrospect, a no-no. I didn't like when NES Ninja Gaiden tossed me all the way back to stage 6-1 and JAC doesn't have to be that way now.

And in fact, it's not anymore! I woke up this morning and immediately went to the comptuer and made some very necessary changes. And lo and behold, they worked right away (thank GOD).

It's a sign of a crappy dev who doesn't take criticism into account, and make changes where possible while still maintaining the integrity of his game.

So, without further ado:
 

============ 
PATCH NOTES 
============ 

*Created a new area in between the 2 final stages of the game, complete with the choice to save your game there. If you do save and get killed, reloading your file will bring you right back to that point. Thanks to Doyledeth and his honest review for getting me to make this, as the game's honestly much better off now.

*Fixed some code for the Church / bless discounts triggering earlier than they should. Sorry, but it wasn't supposed to be cheap that early!

*Increased the raw material requirements of the Katana at P.P. Smith's. This thing just destroys everything, and for a silver class weapon it had to be nerfed a bit materials-wise. The damage and etc remain the same otherwise.

*Sandstorms can now happen during the regular playthrough during the 'Isle of Denial' mission.

Thank you everyone!!
